verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
How can I respond
To the love that You have lavished on me?

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I don't have much, I don't have much
But I have a heart that beats for You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Every part of me
Wants to love You like You've loved me, Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: I have a heart that beats for You

verse.name: b2
verse.lines: I have a life I'll give to You
